name: Liberation
description:
The figure draws the line to my character from the AsyncArt Genesis piece 'First Supper' called 'Stat(u)es of Liberty'.

It is wearing a 'Guy Fawkes‘ mask as used by the hacktivist collective ‚Anonymous‘, which fights against human rights violators, censors and dictators. 

It holds a knotted pistol, which is an allusion to the work "Non Violence" by the Swedish artist C.-F. Reuterswärd and which is standing in front of the UN headquarters in New York as a peace symbol. 

Unlike the famous role model, the figure has not broken the chains, but feels bound by the laws of love.

The title borrows from the song 'Liberation' by Outkast, which has a very special meaning for the artists involved.

This is an Expansion Item for Forever Supper, the biggest cryptoart collaboration. Claim your free Core and customise it with the Expansions you collect here: https://async.market/dynamic-blueprints/63fe742c74e62000a8cf7bb8/async-forever-supper
